author: agent
objective: Estimate the association of short-term municipality-level PM2.5 with all-cancer mortality in Brazil.

scientific_invariants.research_question: Estimate the association of short-term municipality-level PM2.5 with all-cancer mortality in Brazil.
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: Daily all-cancer deaths among Brazilian residents recorded in SIM.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Odds ratio per 10 micrograms per cubic metre increase in lag 0-2 PM2.5.
principal_variants: All-cancer mortality, lag 0-2 PM2.5, conditional logistic regression

article_evidence.finding: Study abstract: Brazilian individual SIM cancer deaths, 2000-2019; municipal daily PM2.5; three-day average; OR per 10 ug/m3.

Complete methods recovered through the open-access article route: 5,570 municipalities, SIM, 0.25-degree daily modelled PM2.5, ERA5 meteorology, population-weighted municipality aggregation, time-stratified case-crossover conditional logistic regression.
